skills.name: boardroom
skills.description: /c-level-agents:boardroom [brief] — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

skills.name: brief
skills.description: /c-level-agents:brief [topic] — Generate a one-page strategy brief from an office-hours intake. First step in the strategic sprint pipeline. Use when a strategic question needs to be framed before boardroom deliberation — e.g. locking options, assumptions, and success criteria for a pricing change or a market-entry decision.

skills.name: c-level-agents
skills.description: Founder-mode executive team. 13 cs-* C-suite agents (CFO, CMO, CRO, CPO, COO, CHRO, CISO, GC, CDO, CAIO, CCO, VPE, Chief of Staff) and 21 /c-level-agents:* slash commands for forcing-question office hours, multi-role boardroom deliberation, strategic sprint pipeline, and meta routing. Use when the founder needs a virtual executive team, when invoking /c-level-agents:* commands, or when orchestrating multi-role decisions.

skills.name: caio-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:caio-review [plan] — Eval-demanding Chief AI Officer interrogation of any plan that involves AI: model selection, risk classification, cost economics, or AI hiring. Use when shipping an AI feature without an eval set, choosing between API, fine-tune, and self-hosted, or classifying a use case under the EU AI Act.

skills.name: cco-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cco-review [plan] — Retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer interrogation of any plan that touches customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or CS team hiring. Use when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.

skills.name: cdo-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cdo-review [plan] — Decision-driven Chief Data Officer interrogation of any plan that touches training data, data architecture, data productization, or data team hiring. Use when validating training-data rights before model work, choosing warehouse vs lakehouse vs mesh, or valuing data assets for productization or M&A.

skills.name: cfo-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cfo-review [plan] — Numerate-skeptic interrogation of any plan that touches money. Unit economics, runway, dilution, capital allocation. Use when a plan commits meaningful spend — e.g. a hiring wave, a fundraise decision, or a new channel budget.

skills.name: ciso-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:ciso-review [plan] — Risk-paranoid interrogation of any plan that touches data, compliance, or production access. Use when launching features that handle customer data, before a SOC 2 / ISO audit, or after any incident or near-miss.

skills.name: cmo-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cmo-review [plan] — Narrative-first interrogation of positioning, ICP, message house, and channel mix. Use when launching a campaign or repositioning, or when CAC is rising and the one-sentence positioning test fails.

skills.name: cpo-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cpo-review [plan] — JTBD-driven interrogation of product roadmap, PMF signal, and portfolio focus. Use when committing a quarter's roadmap, deciding whether to kill a feature, or claiming PMF without a retention curve.

skills.name: cro-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cro-review [plan] — Pipeline-paranoid interrogation of revenue, win rate, NRR, and ramp time. Use when the forecast misses pipeline coverage, win rates drop, or before scaling the sales team.

skills.name: cross-eval
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cross-eval [memo] — Multi-model consensus on a board memo or strategy brief. Claude + Codex + Gemini cross-review with graceful degradation. Use when a high-stakes memo needs an independent sanity check before the boardroom — e.g. a bet-the-company pivot or fundraise terms.

skills.name: cto-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:cto-review [plan] — Architecture and scaling interrogation. Tech debt, scaling cliffs, team scaling, build-vs-buy. Use when committing to an architecture, planning for 10x load, or weighing a rebuild against a vendor.

skills.name: decide
skills.description: /c-level-agents:decide [memo] — Log a decision to two-layer memory via decision-logger. Approved memo becomes durable; raw transcripts kept for reference. Use when the founder has approved a boardroom memo and the decision must become durable company memory — e.g. right after /c-level-agents:boardroom concludes.

skills.name: execute
skills.description: /c-level-agents:execute [decision] — Generate a 90-day execution plan with weekly milestones, DRIs, and check-in cadence from an approved decision. Use when a logged decision needs to become an operating plan — e.g. turning an approved market-entry call into weekly milestones with DRIs.

skills.name: founder-mode
skills.description: /c-level-agents:founder-mode [question] — Auto-routes any founder question to the right C-role advisor or to /c-level-agents:boardroom for multi-role topics. The single-command entry point. Use when a founder asks any strategic question without knowing which advisor or command fits — e.g. 'runway pressure' routes to the CFO, 'gross retention dropped' routes to the CCO.

skills.name: freeze
skills.description: /c-level-agents:freeze [decision] [days] — Lock a strategic decision for a cooldown period to prevent impulse reversal. Mirrors gstack's safety primitives for the business layer. Use when an irreversible decision was made under pressure — e.g. a layoff plan or multi-year contract — and deserves a cooling-off lock before execution.

skills.name: gc-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:gc-review [plan] — General Counsel interrogation of contracts, IP, regulatory, term sheets, and employment-law surface. Use when reviewing a term sheet before signing, redlining a customer MSA, or checking IP assignment and regulatory exposure on a new product.

skills.name: office-hours
skills.description: /c-level-agents:office-hours [topic] — YC-style 6-question founder interrogation before any advice. Forces clarity on problem, customer, distribution, defensibility, capital, and founder fit. Use when a founder question is too vague to route — e.g. 'should we grow faster?' — or before drafting a strategy brief.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: /cs-onboard — Founder interview that populates ~/.claude/company-context.md using the canonical 7-dimension cs-onboard schema. The first command to run when starting with c-level-agents. Use when setting up the virtual C-suite for a new company, or when advisors lack company context — e.g. before a first /c-level-agents:boardroom or after a fundraise changes the numbers.

skills.name: post-mortem
skills.description: /c-level-agents:post-mortem [decision] — Honest retrospective on an executed decision, scored against original assumptions and dissent. Closes the strategic sprint loop. Use when a decision hits its 90-day review checkpoint or its kill criteria trigger — e.g. scoring last quarter's pricing change against its pre-committed success metrics.

skills.name: vpe-review
skills.description: /c-level-agents:vpe-review [plan] — Throughput-first VP of Engineering interrogation of any plan that touches delivery, eng hiring, team structure, or production discipline. Use when cycle time balloons, DORA metrics slide, or before committing to an eng hiring wave or a reorg.
